from __future__ import annotations

"""Deterministic Phase 2 spatial-evidence source for Jing-Zhang In Situ.

This source creates only proposal geometry, metrics, and an auditable source
freeze.  It never upgrades open or provisional data to surveyed, statutory,
or official spatial evidence.  Figures and PDFs are regenerated by the
companion ``phase2-visual-generator.py`` from these exact outputs.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from pyproj import Transformer
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Polygon, mapping, shape
from shapely.ops import transform, unary_union


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
SUB = SCRIPT.parents[2]
ROOT = SCRIPT.parents[5]
GEOM = SUB / "geometry"
CONTEXT = SUB / "visual" / "assets"
TX = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4326", "EPSG:4548", always_xy=True)


def read_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write_json(path: Path, payload) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def write_standard_matrix(path: Path, payload) -> None:
    """Preserve the compact-array style of the audited standard matrix."""
    lines = ["{", f'  "schema_version": {json.dumps(payload["schema_version"], ensure_ascii=False)},', '  "standards": [']
    for item_index, item in enumerate(payload["standards"]):
        lines.append("    {")
        pairs = list(item.items())
        for pair_index, (key, value) in enumerate(pairs):
            comma = "," if pair_index < len(pairs) - 1 else ""
            lines.append(f"      {json.dumps(key, ensure_ascii=False)}: {json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)}{comma}")
        lines.append("    }," if item_index < len(payload["standards"]) - 1 else "    }")
    lines.extend(["  ]", "}"])
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def projected(geometry):
    return transform(TX.transform, geometry)


def area(geometry) -> float:
    return round(float(projected(geometry).area), 3)


def length(geometry) -> float:
    return round(float(projected(geometry).length), 3)


def polygon(coords):
    ring = coords if coords[0] == coords[-1] else [*coords, coords[0]]
    return {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [ring]}


def feature(fid: str, layer: str, geometry: dict, **props):
    properties = {
        "id": fid,
        "layer": layer,
        "source_type": props.pop("source_type", "agent_generated_design"),
        "confidence": props.pop("confidence", "medium"),
        "geometry_role": props.pop("geometry_role", "design_proposal"),
        "status": props.pop("status", "conceptual_design_target"),
        **props,
    }
    return {"type": "Feature", "id": fid, "properties": properties, "geometry": geometry}


def collection(name: str, features: list[dict], **meta):
    return {"type": "FeatureCollection", "name": name, **meta, "features": features}


def rect(x0, y0, x1, y1):
    return polygon([[x0, y0], [x1, y0], [x1, y1], [x0, y1]])

def metric(status, value, unit, source_files, formula, confidence, assumptions, baseline, action, target, evidence, trigger, **extra):
    item = {
        "status": status, "value": value, "unit": unit, "source_files": source_files, "formula": formula,
        "confidence": confidence, "assumptions": assumptions, "baseline": baseline, "action": action,
        "target_or_observation_window": target, "evidence_status": evidence, "recompute_trigger": trigger,
        **extra,
    }
    return item


def build_metrics(geo):
    shp = {name: [(f["id"], shape(f["geometry"]), f["properties"]) for f in fc["features"]] for name, fc in geo.items()}
    site = shp["site_boundary"][0][1]
    site_m = projected(site)
    land_wgs = [g for _, g, _ in shp["land_use"]]
    land_union_wgs = unary_union(land_wgs)
    land_union = projected(land_union_wgs)
    gap_wgs = site.difference(land_union_wgs)
    gap = 0.0 if gap_wgs.is_empty else projected(gap_wgs).area
    overlap = 0.0
    for i in range(len(land_wgs)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(land_wgs)):
            shared = land_wgs[i].intersection(land_wgs[j])

def enrich_sources():
    data = read_json(SUB / "sources.json")
    registry = {x["source_id"]: x for x in read_json(ROOT / "data" / "source_registry.json")["sources"]}
    existing = {x["id"] for x in data["sources"]}
    for source_id in [
        "DATA-SRC-MOHURD-URBAN-DESIGN-MEASURES", "DATA-SRC-MOHURD-CONTROL-DETAILED-PLANNING",
        "DATA-SRC-MNR-LAND-USE-CLASSIFICATION-202311", "DATA-SRC-GENERATIVE-AI-INTERIM-MEASURES",
        "DATA-SRC-BARRIER-FREE-ENVIRONMENT-LAW", "DATA-SRC-ELDERLY-SMART-TECH-PLAN-2020-45",
    ]:
        if source_id in existing:
            continue
        r = registry[source_id]
        data["sources"].append({
            "id": source_id, "title": r["title"], "publisher": r["publisher"], "url": r["url"],
            "local_paths": r["local_paths"], "source_type": "official_public",
            "authority_level": r["authority_level"], "published_date": r["published_date"], "accessed_date": r["accessed_date"],
            "usable_for_formal": r["usable_for_formal"], "allowed_uses": r["allowed_uses"],
            "prohibited_uses": r["prohibited_uses"], "license_summary": r["license_summary"], "limitations": r["notes_zh"],
        })
    if "DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARY-BASIS-20260814" not in existing:
        data["sources"].append({
            "id": "DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARY-BASIS-20260814", "title": "Provisional boundary derivation and mismatch checks",
            "publisher": "Repository maintainers", "path": "brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries_basis.md",
            "source_type": "agent_inferred_from_public_data", "authority_level": "BACKGROUND_ONLY",
            "published_date": "2026-08-14", "accessed_date": "2026-08-27", "usable_for_formal": "background_only",
            "allowed_uses": ["audit derivation chain", "retain negative OSM mismatch results", "define future replacement triggers"],
            "prohibited_uses": ["official boundary correction", "survey or road-redline claim", "heritage-control conclusion", "redistribution of an unregistered raw OSM snapshot"],
            "license_summary": "The repository-authored derivation note follows its source-file rights record; no blanket repository-wide license or raw OSM redistribution right is asserted.",
            "limitations": "The note records a crowdsourced-data mismatch check; it cannot establish legal or surveyed geometry.",
        })
    for src in data["sources"]:
        if src["id"] == "DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARY-BASIS-20260814":
            src["license_summary"] = "The repository-authored derivation note follows its source-file rights record; no blanket repository-wide license or raw OSM redistribution right is asserted."
        paths = list(src.get("local_paths", []))
        if src.get("path"):
            paths.append(src["path"])
        hashes = []
        for rel in paths:
            path = ROOT / rel
            if path.is_file():
                hashes.append({"path": rel.replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": digest(path)})
        src.update({
            "retrieval_or_publication_date": src.get("accessed_date") or src.get("published_date"),
            "spatial_scope": src.get("spatial_scope", "project/corridor relevance only as stated; no geometry transfer unless explicitly listed"),
            "temporal_scope": src.get("published_date") or "undated source, bounded by accessed date",
            "acquisition_chain": "Repository registry or cited first-party URL -> local reference where licensed/cleared -> Phase 2 source freeze metadata.",
            "transformation_chain": "UTF-8 read -> claim-level extraction/paraphrase -> structured source/metric/geometry reference; no raster or map copying.",
            "content_hashes": hashes,
            "hash_status": "local_snapshot_hashed" if hashes else "url_only_no_redistributable_snapshot",
            "evidence_grade": src.get("usable_for_formal", "background_only"),
            "redistribution_status": "existing_repository_snapshot_rights_follow_item_record" if hashes else "metadata_and_link_only",
        })
        metadata_record = {
            key: src.get(key) for key in [
                "id", "title", "publisher", "url", "path", "published_date", "accessed_date",
                "usable_for_formal", "allowed_uses", "prohibited_uses", "license_summary", "limitations",
                "spatial_scope", "temporal_scope", "acquisition_chain", "transformation_chain",
            ]
        }
        src["metadata_record_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(metadata_record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        src["metadata_hash_scope"] = "Canonical source metadata only; for URL-only sources this is explicitly not a hash of remote webpage content."
    data["schema_version"] = "0.1.0"
    data["accessed_date"] = "2026-08-27"
    data["phase2_freeze_policy"] = "Every local snapshot is hash-bound. URL-only precedents remain link-and-paraphrase metadata; open data never becomes survey, cadastral, statutory, or official design geometry."
    write_json(SUB / "sources.json", data)
    return data
